dialogues.value: Great, you're still around 305. Thought we lost you with the communivations. Navigate the area carefully, theres something big down there and its messing with our coms.
Does this mean I get a bonus?
What was that? You're cutting out again.
Alright, 305. We have sent the vendor again this time. Meet up with him if you need any assistance and pick up any of the beacons that are still available.
I better be getting compensated for all this stuff I've had to buy.
We'll sort that out with your bonus when you get back on board the ship.
So I am geting a bonus.
Ah what... it looks like you're cutting out again. Good luck out there 305.
Oh hey, it's me, your favourite bin man! You remember the deal from last time.
You're going to need pay up yet again if you want to continue. Don't worry, this time its worth it. This path should help deal with the big guy downstairs.
You can buy your way over for 500 credits. I sure do hope you've got enough. Otherwise, just jump down there and face him yourself.
Really? More money? You're real greedy.
